task.name: Preflight delegates to a sub-agent it cannot be resumed for, is killed with no evidence gathered, and a fallback proceeds on the complexity it never founded
task.story_text:
## Observed

The preflight agent delegates its investigation to a sub-agent, writes a closing sentence saying it
is waiting for that sub-agent, and ends its turn. Ending the turn finishes the stream, so the harness
closes stdin and starts the grace period it allows a finished agent to exit in. The agent does not
exit, because it is still holding a live background sub-agent that nothing will ever wake it for.
When the grace period expires the agent is killed by signal.

The result is a phase that consumed several tool calls, inspected no files, and produced no
classification. Its recorded outputs are a fragment of prose about waiting, and a file-inspection
count of zero.

This has been happening since 2026-04-26, in roughly one run in thirty — 20 of 596 recorded run logs — and has almost never been visible.
When a story carries no risk signals the failure is absorbed: the run reports the phase as failed and
proceeds anyway in a degraded mode. So for months, runs have been dispatched on a preflight that read
nothing, while the values preflight exists to produce — complexity, and the routing, timeouts and
allocation derived from it — were still emitted and still consumed downstream. A run in this state
prints a complexity classification sourced from a phase that inspected zero files.

It became visible only when a story that had been attempted several times acquired a risk signal for
prior execution on its branch. With a signal present the same failure escalates instead of
proceeding, and the story stops before any work is dispatched. Retrying the story is what surfaced a
defect that had been silently degrading every run for four months.

The degraded path is the more expensive half. A hard stop costs one minute and a fraction of a
dollar and tells an operator something is wrong. A silent proceed costs a full sprint routed on
values derived from nothing, and tells no one.

## Expected

A phase that produced no evidence is not treated as though it produced evidence. Where a phase exists
to classify or measure something and it did not complete, the values it would have produced are
either absent or explicitly marked as unfounded, so a later stage cannot consume a figure that no
observation supports.

Where a run continues after a phase failed, the fact that it is continuing on a degraded basis is
carried into the run's own record and its operator-facing summary, not only into a log line at the
moment of failure, so a completed run states what it proceeded without. A degradation that repeats
for months without anyone noticing is indistinguishable from correct operation, and that is the
property that has to change.

An agent that hands work to something it cannot wait for has not finished its turn. Where the
execution context offers no mechanism to resume an agent after a delegated task completes, the agent
is not given the means to delegate, so it cannot reach a state where its only remaining action is to
wait for an event that will not occur.

Whether a failure stops a run may depend on accumulated risk. What that failure *is* may not: the
same defect is reported the same way whether or not a risk signal happens to be present, so its
frequency is knowable from the run record rather than from the subset of occasions it happened to
block.

## Diagnosis

**Observed symptom.** Preflight ends with a signal kill, having inspected zero files, and either
escalates the story or is absorbed by a degraded-proceed fallback depending on whether an unrelated
risk signal is present.

**Evidence.**

- Run log for one story: `↳ Agent: Investigate sandbox process teardown` at 03:09:56, last tool call
  at 03:09:59, kill recorded at 03:10:10 — 11.4 seconds after the final tool call, against a stated
  phase timeout of 300s that was nowhere near reached.
- `runners/runner_claude.py` defines the grace period allowed after a finished stream before the CLI
  is killed, documented as a bounded wait for orderly shutdown, with a value of 10 seconds. The
  observed interval matches it.
- Recorded agent output in four separate runs on one day: variations of waiting for a background,
  explore, exploration, or investigation agent, or for a scheduled wakeup or completion
  notification. Each reports 0 files inspected across 1 to 4 tool calls.
- Occurrences appear in run logs on 2026-04-26, 04-28, 05-01, 05-02, 05-09, 05-11, 05-12, 07-17,
  07-26, 07-27, 08-02, 08-03, 08-04 and 08-08/09 — 20 occurrences against 596 recorded run logs over the same period, about 3.4%.
- Historical runs record `PREFLIGHT failed (exit=-9) — no risk signals; fallback PROCEED (degraded)`
  and continue; the recent run records the same failure `with risk signals
  [prior_execution_on_branch] — escalating` and stops.
- The escalating run still emitted `Complexity: HIGH (from preflight)` and derived routing, worker
  timeout and story allocation from it, after the phase inspected zero files.

**Ruled out.** Not the phase timeout: the kill lands at 26 seconds of a 300-second allowance. Not the
worker or sprint ceiling: neither was near. Not budget: the phase cost about $0.21. Not a defect in
any particular story, since occurrences span unrelated stories over four months. Not the escalation
policy, which behaved as specified — refusing to dispatch against an unverified contract is the
correct response to the input it was given. Not authentication, which produces a different exit code
and message and is visible separately in the same period.

**Confirmed cause.** The preflight agent has the means to delegate to a sub-agent but no means to be
resumed when that sub-agent finishes, so it ends its turn while a delegated task is outstanding; the
harness reads a finished stream as a finished agent and kills the process when it does not exit. The
resulting evidence-free phase is then admitted by a fallback that proceeds without recording that it
did so, which is why the defect persisted undetected.

**Affected code path.** Preflight agent invocation and its available tool surface; the post-stream
exit grace and kill in the agent runner; the risk-signal branch that chooses between escalation and
degraded proceed; and the derivation of complexity and downstream limits from preflight output.

**Fix-success criterion.** Preflight cannot reach a state whose only remaining action is waiting for
an event that cannot occur; a preflight that inspected nothing does not yield a complexity
classification that downstream stages consume as founded; and a run that proceeded on a degraded
phase says so in its own summary, so the frequency of this condition is readable from run records
without searching logs.

Converted resolve_preflight_tools from a deny-list to an allow-list, which is the finding worth taking because it strengthens the story's own invariant: a deny-list only asks whether today's known-dangerous tool is absent, so any tool added to a default set joins preflight's surface unreviewed — and API_PROVIDER_DEFAULT_TOOLS already carried submit_review into a phase that reviews nothing. The empty-result fallback to PREFLIGHT_READ_ONLY_TOOLS is unchanged. PREFLIGHT_FORBIDDEN_TOOLS now names only the load-bearing denial rather than governing the surface, and the resolver reports it as its own category so 'dropped Bash (delegation-capable)' is not buried beside a merely off-phase tool. finding_registry.description: When a Claude preflight profile is configured with Bash as its only allowed tool, the preflight invocation is launched without any explicit tool allowlist, so the run has no mechanical restriction proving Bash was denied.

Narrowing DEFAULT_PREFLIGHT_PROFILE.allowed_tools to (Read, Glob, Grep) also removes Bash from diagnose_flow._build_diagnose_profile and escalation_advisor_flow, which both reuse config.preflight_profile as their base profile and now silently lose a tool they previously held.
PREFLIGHT_DEGRADED_ROW_KEYS is defined with a detailed docstring but never referenced anywhere in src/ or tests/, so it documents a row-key contract the code does not actually enforce or reuse.

When a preflight profile is configured with an empty allowed_tools list, the sanitizer returns it unchanged and the Claude runner omits --allowedTools, so preflight runs with the CLI default tool surface instead of the read-only allowlist.

Plan agent profiles are still constructed with allowed_tools=config.preflight_profile.allowed_tools in plan_flow.py's non-adaptive/fallback branch and in preflight.py when building explicit planner overrides, so after the default preflight profile was narrowed to Read/Glob/Grep, the plan agent silently loses Bash even though role_derivation.py now uses DEFAULT_INVESTIGATION_TOOLS for plan.

When an API-transport PLAN, diagnose, or escalation-advisor profile receives the restored investigation surface, the API runner grants the bash tool while sandbox/auth readiness classifies the same profile as having no bash surface.

The live-status detail dict carries the degraded-preflight block only for the two PREFLIGHT state updates, and later phases replace the detail dict wholesale, so a story that ran on conservative values shows the degradation on its live row only while the phase is still PREFLIGHT and loses it once DEV/PLAN/REVIEW overwrite the detail block.

build_argv omits --allowedTools for any role whose allowed_tools is empty, which hands the CLI its unrestricted default including Bash, so a dev, review, or plan profile with an empty allowlist runs with the full tool surface rather than failing closed.

resolve_preflight_tools preserves unknown tool names unchanged, so an API-transport preflight profile derived from API_PROVIDER_DEFAULT_TOOLS keeps the phase-inappropriate submit_review tool after Bash is stripped, and any future tool added to the default API set is not reviewed against the preflight delegation invariant.

When a Claude profile reaches dispatch with an empty allowed_tools tuple, the argv builder omits --allowedTools, so the process runs with the Claude CLI default tool surface instead of an explicit empty surface.
